title: Help

faqQuestions(map).replyTime: When will I get an answer?
faqQuestions(map).offline: What if I send without internet?
faqQuestions(map).reportBug: How do I report a bug?

faqAnswers(map).offline: Your message stays saved and goes out when you're online again.
faqAnswers(map).privacy: Only the support team. Nothing is shared with your partner.
faqAnswers(map).reportBug: Choose Bug in the form and tell us what happened.

pendingNote: A message is saved and will be sent when you're online.
discardedNote: A saved message couldn't be sent and was removed. Write to us again if it still matters.
messageHint: Tell us what happened, with as much detail as you like.
sentText: Thanks. We reply within 2 business days.
queuedText: We'll send it when you're back online. It hasn't been delivered yet.

errors(map).RATE_LIMITED: You sent several messages today. Try again tomorrow.
errors(map).noData: Couldn't send right now. Your message is still here.
errors(map).other: Couldn't send right now. Your message is still here.

discardText: What you wrote won't be saved.
